display.summary: Document files with images as PDF pages and the acting user shown in file history.
highlights: File history shows who edited or replaced the PDF, with a full-name or username display and an unknown-actor fallback.
register_document_file(Model, "pdf_file") connects the file card, Scan, viewer, page editor, downloads and file history for a field, with permission and scope checks.
JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIF, TIFF and WebP become PDF pages; pages can be rotated and fitted to A4 in the editor.
The PDF editor scans through ScanLink like the file card; file history lives in DjangoLux (dlux.FileVersion) and dlux_adopt_file_history moves a project's own rows over.
Includes 1.12.0b1: deleting keeps history (soft bulk delete, history-safe user deletion).
